```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = '') # results = 'hold'
```

***

# Read the Data

```{r}
data <- read.csv('chicago_taxi_trip_sample.csv')

dim(data)
```

# Logistic Regression

```{r}
# Construct binary response variable y
data$tips_5 <- data$tips >= 5

str(data)
```

```{r}
model <- glm(tips_5 ~ fare, family = binomial, data = data)

summary(model)
```

# Model Selection

```{r}
# Do feature engineering
data$airport <- (data$pickup_area %in% c('Midway', 'O\'Hare') |
                 data$dropoff_area %in% c('Midway', 'O\'Hare'))

# Fit small model
small.model <- glm(tips_5 ~ fare + airport, family = binomial, data = data)

# Fit large model with interaction term
large.model <- glm(tips_5 ~ fare * airport, family = binomial, data = data)
```

## Wald $z$-test

```{r}
# Wald z-test to select explanatory variable
summary(large.model)
```

## $\mathcal{X}^2$ likelihood ratio test LRT

```{r}
# X^2 likelihood ratio test LRT to select model
anova(small.model, large.model)
```

## AIC

```{r}
# AIC to select model
c(AIC(small.model), AIC(large.model))
```
